en.title: Tactics on the new race page
en.body: Pick a plan for the whole team, and every rider follows it. Give a rider his own Easy, Medium or Hard day with one tap, or tap it again to send him back to the team plan. Day load shows what the day costs him. Lock a rider to keep his plan when you change the team plan. All orders shows each rider's orders along the route.

da.title: Taktik på den nye løbsside
da.body: Vælg en plan for hele holdet, og alle ryttere følger den. Giv en rytter sin egen Let, Middel eller Hård dag med ét tryk, eller tryk igen for at sende ham tilbage til holdets plan. Dagens belastning viser, hvad dagen koster ham. Lås en rytter, så han beholder sin plan, når du skifter holdplan. Alle ordrer viser hver rytters ordrer langs ruten.
